description.narrative: ...The Government of Libya has requested UNIDO#s assistance to phase-out HCFC. The Executive Committee approved stage I of the HPMP for Libya at its 75th meeting, and further approved the second and final tranche of stage I of the HPMP at its 82nd meeting. The ExCom approved the extension of HPMP I to December 2022 at its 89th meeting. HPMP I for Libya covers investment and non-investment components: - The conversion of two foam companies to cyclopentane - Capacity building of RAC servicing technicians and customs officers - Awareness campaigns - Procurement of training tools and equipment
